caseName: Bloch v. General Motors Acceptance Corp.
caseNameFull: Bloch et ux. v. General Motors Acceptance Corp.

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 2d Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of cer-tiorari, certiorari denied.
